steps.instruction: Cut 3 large ripe tomatoes into small dice.
Cut 1 green bell pepper and 1 small onion into small dice.
Add 1 handful of finely chopped fresh coriander and 1 teaspoon of ground cumin.
Add salt, black pepper and 2 tablespoons of vinegar or lemon juice.
Put everything in a container and close the lid tightly.
Shake the container well to combine everything.
Let the salad rest for 30 minutes before serving.
steps.spoken: Let the salad rest for 30 minutes so the flavors can mingle before serving.
